title: A page reload the user cancels leaves the cloud picker locked until it is closed and reopened
evidence: Done 2026-11-13 (US-09 AC45a): useSwitchFlow (switch-flow.ts) runs one effect keyed on the navigating run; after HAND_OFF_MS (15 s) it dispatches stayed at that run, which ends navigating as reopened does. A stopped load sends the old page no event, so a timer is the only signal (design: docs/drafts/c27-c28-design.md). Was: A finished move hands the page to a reload (widget-src/standalone/switch-flow.ts: settled leads to navigating). If the reload does not happen, the flow stays navigating while the picker is open; restored comes only from a back-forward cache page show, and reopened only when the picker mounts again, which returns it to idle.
